meta_title: AccBot | Free, open-source Bitcoin DCA app
meta_description: Free, open-source Android app that buys Bitcoin and other crypto on a schedule, straight from your own exchange account. Five exchanges, no middleman, no cloud.
hero_subtitle: AccBot is completely free and open source. It buys Bitcoin for you on a schedule, straight from your own exchange account, and runs on your phone, so there's no cloud service and no middleman taking a cut. You only pay the exchange's usual fee.
value_custody_desc: API keys never leave your phone. They're encrypted with AES-256-GCM in the Android Keystore. Nothing goes to the cloud and nothing is tracked.
value_auto_desc: Set up a plan once and AccBot keeps buying on schedule, even while your phone sits in your pocket.
value_open_desc: The code is public under the MIT license. No subscription, no premium tier, no data collection. You only pay your exchange's usual trading fee.
features_strategies_desc: Pick the strategy that suits you. Classic DCA buys the same amount every time. ATH-based DCA buys more the further the price drops below its all-time high. Fear & Greed DCA follows market sentiment and buys more when others panic.
features_strategies_classic_desc: The same amount at regular intervals
features_strategies_ath_desc: 0.5× near the ATH, up to 3× when 80% or more below it
features_strategies_fg_desc: 0.25× at extreme greed, 2.5× at extreme fear
features_portfolio_desc: Interactive charts show what you hold, how much you've made and how each plan is doing. See your average buy price and today's value, per exchange and per trading pair.
features_history_desc: Every purchase in one place, filterable by coin, exchange and status. Export it to CSV for your tax return or your own spreadsheets.
features_sandbox_desc: Try everything on the Binance spot testnet without risking real money. Test plans, orders and keys are kept completely separate from your real ones.
features_withdrawal_desc: Set a balance limit and AccBot reminds you when it's time to move your coins from the exchange to your own wallet.
features_qr_title: Set up with a QR code
features_qr_desc: Scan API keys and wallet addresses with your camera instead of typing long strings of characters by hand.
features_backup_desc: Back up your plans, purchase history and, if you like, your API keys with a single tap. The backup is encrypted with your password using AES-256-GCM. Moving to a new phone takes a few seconds, and you don't need an account.
more_sells_desc: Place limit sell orders on Coinmate and Binance right from the app (Android).
more_import_desc: Bring in earlier purchases through the exchange API or a CSV file, so your stats start from day one.
more_share_desc: Show a plan to your partner or a friend. Send a snapshot, or live updates with a separate read-only key. They can look, but they can't trade.
more_watch_desc: AccBot keeps an eye on battery optimization, exact alarms and notifications, and tells you how to fix anything that could stop a purchase.
screenshots_subtitle: Real screenshots from the Android app.
shot_dashboard: Dashboard with your plans and market mood
shot_portfolio: Portfolio value and average buy price
exchanges_subtitle: Run DCA plans on five exchanges. On Android you can also place limit sells on Coinmate and Binance.
security_subtitle: AccBot has no server of its own. Everything happens on your phone, and your data stays there.
security_aes_desc: API keys are protected by the hardware-backed Android Keystore
security_local_desc: Nothing is uploaded to any server
security_direct_desc: The app talks to your exchange over HTTPS with nobody in between
security_biometric_desc: Optionally unlock the app with your fingerprint or face
security_opensource_desc: Anyone can read the code, published under the MIT license
security_nocloud_desc: No analytics, no ads, no telemetry
howto_step1_desc: Create an API key on your exchange with trading permission only, then scan its QR code or paste it in.
howto_step2_desc: Choose the coin, amount, frequency and strategy: Classic, ATH-based or Fear & Greed.
howto_step3_desc: AccBot buys in the background on your schedule, and you follow the results in your portfolio.
compare_subtitle: Štosuj, a popular Czech DCA service, buys on Coinmate through Quick Buy with a markup of about 1.5%, and daily purchases, dynamic DCA or automatic withdrawals need a subscription from CZK 150 + VAT a month. With AccBot you buy on Coinmate directly for the exchange's standard 0.6% taker fee, and every feature is free. See what that adds up to over time.

compare_disclaimer: This is a simulation. It uses daily BTC/USD prices from Bitstamp converted to CZK at ECB reference rates, fees of 0.6% and 1.5%, and Štosuj's price list (PREMIUM CZK 150, PRO CZK 450 a month + 21% VAT when paying by card, as of November 2026). The subscription comes out of the same budget, so Štosuj buys less by its share. Prepaid credit packs can be somewhat cheaper. Withdrawal fees and taxes are left out.
faq_a1: Yes. AccBot is open source under the MIT license and costs nothing. There's no subscription and no extra fee on your purchases. You only pay your exchange's normal trading fee.
faq_q2: Can AccBot withdraw or lose my money?
faq_a2: AccBot only works with the API key you create on your exchange. Give the key permission to trade and leave withdrawals turned off. The key is stored encrypted on your phone, and AccBot only ever sends it to your exchange.
faq_q3: Does my phone need to be on?
faq_a3: Yes. Purchases run on your phone, so it needs to be switched on and online. Android sometimes delays background tasks by a few minutes. If a purchase is missed, for example while the phone was off, AccBot shows it on the dashboard and lets you buy it later or skip it.
faq_a4: Purchased coins land in your exchange account. AccBot can remind you when your balance reaches a limit you choose, so you can move it to your own wallet.
faq_q5: Which coins and currencies are supported?
faq_a5: You can buy BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA, DOT, LTC and BNB with EUR, USD, GBP, CZK, USDT or USDC. What's available depends on your exchange.
faq_a6: The iOS app is in the works. For now AccBot is available for Android on Google Play and GitHub.
faq_q7: Can I try it without real money?
faq_a7: Yes. Turn on sandbox mode and AccBot trades on the Binance spot testnet with test funds.

privacy_intro: AccBot ("the App") is a self-custody cryptocurrency DCA (Dollar Cost Averaging) tool developed by Crynners. This privacy policy explains how the App handles your data.
privacy_collection_text: AccBot does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on external servers. All data remains exclusively on your device.
privacy_stored_text: The following data is stored locally on your device only:
privacy_stored_item1: Exchange API credentials (encrypted with AES-256-GCM via Android Keystore)
privacy_stored_item2: DCA plan configurations (crypto pair, amount, frequency, strategy)
privacy_stored_item3: Transaction history (purchase records from your DCA executions)
privacy_stored_item5: Withdrawal history (records of crypto withdrawals to your wallets)
privacy_stored_item6: Exchange balance snapshots (cached account balances for portfolio display)
privacy_stored_item7: Cached market price data (cryptocurrency prices fetched from third-party APIs)
privacy_stored_item8: Notification history (records of app notifications and alerts)
privacy_network_intro: The App communicates with the following external services via HTTPS. All connections are encrypted in transit. No personal data is intentionally sent; however, your device's IP address is exposed to these services as part of normal network communication.
privacy_network_exchanges_text: The App connects directly to exchanges you configure (e.g. Coinmate, Binance, Kraken, KuCoin, Bitfinex, Huobi, Coinbase) to execute trades, retrieve balances, and fetch order data. Only your API credentials and trade parameters are sent.
privacy_network_market_text: The App fetches cryptocurrency prices and market data from CoinGecko (coingecko.com), CryptoCompare (cryptocompare.com), and Alternative.me (alternative.me) for the Fear & Greed Index. No personal data or API credentials are sent to these services. The App only makes standard HTTPS requests for public market data.
privacy_network_mlkit_text: The App uses Google ML Kit for barcode scanning and text recognition. ML Kit processes data on-device, but the SDK may send diagnostic data to Google, including device information, app info, per-installation identifiers, and performance metrics. This data is not used for advertising or user profiling. This data collection is managed by Google and is described in Google's Privacy Policy.
privacy_security_text: AccBot employs multiple layers of security to protect your data:
privacy_security_item1: Exchange API credentials are encrypted using AES-256-GCM with keys stored in the hardware-backed Android Keystore
privacy_security_item2: Sensitive app preferences are stored using EncryptedSharedPreferences
privacy_security_item3: All network communication uses HTTPS encryption in transit
privacy_security_item4: All app data is stored in app-private storage, inaccessible to other applications
privacy_security_item5: Optional biometric authentication (fingerprint or face recognition) adds an additional layer of access protection
privacy_security_item6: Exported backups are encrypted with a user-chosen password using AES-256-GCM
privacy_perm_internet: Internet: Required to communicate with exchange APIs for executing trades and fetching market data
privacy_perm_camera: Camera: Used exclusively for scanning QR codes containing API keys or wallet addresses. Camera data is not stored or transmitted.
privacy_perm_battery: Battery optimization exemption: Required for reliable background execution of scheduled DCA purchases
privacy_perm_alarm: Exact alarms: Required for precise scheduling of DCA purchase executions
privacy_perm_foreground: Foreground service: Required to monitor and execute DCA plans in the background
privacy_perm_notifications: Notifications: Used to inform you about DCA execution results, errors, and plan status updates
privacy_perm_network: Network state: Used to check internet connectivity before attempting trade executions
privacy_perm_boot: Boot completed: Allows the App to reschedule DCA plans after device restart
privacy_perm_wakelock: Wake lock: Ensures the device stays awake long enough to complete trade executions
privacy_thirdparty_text: AccBot does not integrate any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services. The App communicates with the following third-party services:
privacy_thirdparty_exchanges: Cryptocurrency exchanges (Coinmate, Binance, Kraken, KuCoin, Bitfinex, Huobi, Coinbase), but only the ones you connect yourself, to place trades and read balances
privacy_thirdparty_coingecko: CoinGecko: used for cryptocurrency price data and market information
privacy_thirdparty_cryptocompare: CryptoCompare: used for cryptocurrency price data and all-time high tracking
privacy_thirdparty_alternative: Alternative.me: used for the Fear & Greed Index used in the Fear & Greed DCA strategy
privacy_thirdparty_mlkit: Google ML Kit: on-device barcode scanning and text recognition. ML Kit may collect diagnostic data as described in Google's Privacy Policy. This data is not used for advertising or user profiling.
privacy_deletion_text: AccBot does not require user registration or user accounts. All data can be deleted by using the "Delete All Data" option in Settings, or by uninstalling the App. Since no data is stored externally, uninstallation removes all traces of your data.
privacy_children_text: AccBot is not intended for use by children under 18. The App facilitates cryptocurrency trading which is subject to age restrictions in most jurisdictions.
privacy_biometric_text: AccBot offers an optional biometric lock (fingerprint or face recognition) to protect access to the App. Biometric data is handled entirely by the Android operating system and is never accessed, stored, or transmitted by AccBot. The App only receives a success/failure result from the system biometric prompt.
privacy_backup_text: AccBot allows you to export encrypted backups of your data, including DCA plans, transaction history, and optionally your exchange API credentials. Backup files are encrypted with a password you choose using AES-256-GCM encryption. Backup files are saved to your device's local storage and are never uploaded to any server by the App. You are responsible for the security of exported backup files.
privacy_retention_text: All data is stored locally on your device for as long as the App is installed. There are no server-side retention policies because no data is stored on external servers. You can delete specific data (individual DCA plans, transaction history) within the App, or use "Delete All Data" in Settings to erase everything. Uninstalling the App permanently removes all locally stored data.
privacy_rights_text: Because AccBot stores all data locally on your device and does not collect personal data on any server, you have full control over your data at all times. You can view, export, or delete any data through the App's interface. If you are in the EU (GDPR) or California (CCPA), please note that AccBot does not process personal data on external servers, so typical data subject access requests do not apply. For any privacy concerns, please contact us.
privacy_international_text: When AccBot communicates with cryptocurrency exchanges and market data providers, your requests are sent to servers that may be located in various countries worldwide. These connections are encrypted via HTTPS. AccBot does not control the location of third-party servers. Please review the privacy policies of the exchanges and services you use.
privacy_changes_text: Any changes to this privacy policy will be published in the app's source code repository and reflected on this page.
privacy_contact_text: For questions about this privacy policy or the App, you can reach us at crynners@gmail.com or open an issue on our GitHub repository.
